summary: No new role cleared every hard gate. Filigran lacks a numerical salary floor; AGON lacks explicit attendance and senior/staff requirements; Nango does not establish AI-primary work or explicit France eligibility. Docker and Mendo listings are unavailable. All five entries are exclusions or near-misses, not recommendations.
coverage: 19 official Ashby boards retrieved and screened from 25 attempted endpoints, supplemented by web discovery. Five leads examined in detail: Filigran, Nango, Docker, Mendo and an AGON careers-page role/application modal. Three application forms rendered; Docker and Mendo application paths were unavailable. This is a bounded search, not an exhaustive market census; board screening is discovery rather than verification of every opening.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; titles alone do not establish scope or level.
Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Equity is not cash; estimates, packages and upper bounds do not pass.
No unchanged previously reported selections. Historical qualification and checked dates remain historical, not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Evidence checked October 15, 2026. Posting dates are recorded employer/ATS dates, not a claim that every lead is newly posted today.

Six attempted Ashby board aliases returned 404; that does not establish those employers have no vacancies. The configured extraction service was unavailable; official APIs, direct retrieval and browser rendering supplied verification.

Mendo's WTTJ page returned 403. Its readable official API identified an archived record and linked the employer Teamtailor page, which returned HTTP 410 and explicitly said the offer was unavailable. Discovery snippets did not prove a live opening.

AGON publishes an annual base range and equity, but does not explicitly label gross compensation, state hybrid attendance or document senior/staff entry requirements in the role summary. Its application modal is reachable, not proof of hiring responsiveness.

Nango's USD range is retained in its original currency. No EUR comparison was performed because AI-primary duties and explicit France eligibility were not established; no positive pay-gate claim is made.

Deduplication covers accessible October 10–14 reports, available board snapshots and supplied earlier continuity. Earlier original reports were not accessible in this checkout; complete historical deduplication is not claimed. Unchanged prior selections were not reused.

No employer advanced to separate product/company diligence. Funding, current financial condition, total employee size and recent material activity are not publicly verified in this run. Listing descriptions are not independent company verification.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. No newly qualifying application is recommended. Independent follow-up on any near-miss should first establish qualifying annual gross cash-base terms and all unresolved location, seniority and role-scope gates. No applications or outreach were made.
